notes:
Background: mid-market product analytics vendor. Started with Hosted API pilot (search + support bot) — good qualitative results for intent coverage but cost and tail-latency concerns. Team wants Dedicated for predictable throughput and VPC.

Call snippets / paraphrases:
-	"Hosted API was easy to integrate; we want the same API surface when we move to Dedicated." — VP Eng
-	"Main blocker is data residency + SOC2 evidence for our procurement team." — Head of Security

POC ask (from AE/SE calls):
-	2-week Dedicated POC (staging) to validate canary routing + fallback plan.
-	Traffic split: canary 10% user traffic routed to Dedicated nodes in us-west for 14 days, 90% stays on Hosted API variant.
-	Fallback policy: automatic fallback to hosted_api model-variant if Dedicated node error / latency > SLO or capacity limits reached.
-	Region failover: if us-west Dedicated capacity degraded, route canary to eu-west Dedicated variant (same model family) for resilience testing.
-	Rollback: immediate rollout back to hosted_api default and disable dedicated routing; SE must confirm KV cache invalidation steps.

Acceptance criteria for POC:
-	Latency: p50 < 150ms, p95 < 400ms for chat/generation 512-token median flow on dedicated nodes.
-	Throughput: sustained 120 rps on Dedicated pool with autoscale triggers validated.
-	Fallback correctness: simulated Dedicated failover results in < 2s additional latency and no lost requests.
-	Quality parity: sampling of 200 prompts show no > 10% drop in NLU intent match vs hosted baseline.

Security & infra items in flight:
-	SOC2 docs shared (drive link). security team to confirm, asked for encryption at rest key policy (KMS).
-	Requested VPC peering diagram + egress rules; infra team working on peering window.
-	Legal requested data residency commitment for embeddings (EU) — need guidance on regional subsetting and retention controls.

Pricing and procurement notes:
-	Finance pushed back on committed spend level. initial committed proposal ~ $120k ARR for Dedicated pool to hit their throughput needs.
-	Requested trial credit or temporary committed discount to champion the internal case.

Sales/AE shorthand next actions:
-	Finalize SOW & send by 2026-03-15.
-	Schedule POC kickoff (2h) with Eng, Security, and SE on 2026-03-18.
-	SE to prepare canary routing example config (policy: 10% by cookie stickiness, fallback to hosted_api model variant).

Misc / CRM noise:
-	Contact list: VP Eng (Aisha Rao), Head of Security (Tom Ericksen), Product Lead (Marta Silva).
-	"Likes Redwood console metrics — cost by token and per-route breakdown" — product lead.
-	Raised question about on-prem option for future air-gapped compliance but not required for this PO C.
